market_question: Will Neymar play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
reasoning: Neymar will be 34 by the 2026 World Cup, coming off a major ACL injury in late 2023, with his post-Al-Hilal career path unclear. Brazil now has a wealth of younger attacking talent (Vinícius, Rodrygo, Endrick), reducing his guarantee of a squad place even if fit. While his reputation gives him a high chance of selection if he performs, the substantial reinjury and decline risks make an 81% Yes probability too high; I estimate true Yes likelihood around 70%.
evidence_points: Neymar's age (34 by 2026) and extensive injury history, including a severe ACL tear in October 2023.
Brazil's attacking depth with Vinícius Jr, Rodrygo, Endrick, and others increasing competition for starting spots.
Uncertainty about his performance level after returning from ACL surgery and where he will play club football leading up to the World Cup.
sources_consulted: Neymar's past statements on 2026 World Cup aspirations
Current Brazil national team squad depth information
